response.justification: While Bogdan is an experienced and skilled developer with strong software craftsmanship practices, he is fundamentally mismatched for this embedded networking security role. Most critically, he lacks the required native-level Japanese language proficiency—a hard requirement for the position. His career has been predominantly in web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, modern web platforms) with no demonstrated experience in embedded firmware, LAN-switch products, or the specific security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption/key exchange, attack detection) and networking protocols (NETCONF, SNMP, Layer 2/3) required for this role. While he has some C and Linux experience, they do not appear to be at the level of proficiency required for embedded UNIX systems development.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (15+ years) with proven track record of shipping products and leading technical initiatives across multiple domains
Strong emphasis on testing practices, TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship indicates quality-focused and disciplined development approach
Some experience with C, C++, and Linux systems demonstrates ability to work across different programming languages and technical contexts
concerns: No native-level Japanese language proficiency despite being a hard requirement; resume shows only German (Basic) and English (Fluent)
Career trajectory is predominantly web and full-stack development with no demonstrated experience in embedded firmware development or security-focused systems engineering

No evidence of expertise in required security technologies (MACsec, encryption key exchange, 802.1X, attack detection) or networking protocols (NETCONF, SNMP, Layer 2/3, network switch operation, Telemetry)
